Game Overview

At its heart, Truck Simulator Power Slider is a simulation game about slide your way through realistic trucking challenges. Manipulate fragmented images of mighty trucks by shifting tiles into place, completing captivating high-quality puzzles. Test your spatial skills and enjoy the thrill of assembling powerful vehicles, merging the worlds of trucking and puzzle-solving into a delightful brain-teasing experience.
